description.value: Silver Creek Cookhouse is a casual diner on Alaska Road North in Fort St. John, serving breakfast, coffee, burgers, and sandwiches — the kind of hearty, no-frills fuel a touring cyclist needs after grinding through northeastern BC. It sits along the Alaska Highway corridor, making it a natural waypoint for riders heading north toward Dawson Creek or beyond. Air conditioning provides a welcome break on hot summer days in the Peace River region.

address.value: 10104 Alaska Road North, Fort St. John, V1J 1A8
